identity.product_outcome: A local Song release-readiness plan with explicit deliverable state, backward milestones, approved-Version separation, durable plan lineage and normal /release consumer reachability without provider execution authority.

bounded_increment.description: Preserve the bounded local Release readiness/backward-planning customer journey for reconstruction on a repaired current main.

semantic_contract.required_behavior: Maintain one current immutable-target release plan per Song with archived lineage, explicit deliverable states, deterministic artist-entered backward milestones, exact revision binding and a local readiness-for-review journey without inventing provider or legal truth.
non_negotiable_semantics: release plan is not release authorization
artist-entered target date is not provider-confirmed release date
approved Version is distinct from latest Version and delivered-master readiness
required deliverables cannot silently become NOT_REQUIRED
empty required-deliverable sets cannot report READY_FOR_REVIEW
artist-entered READY is not provider acceptance or independent verification
rights and credits context is not legal clearance
milestones derive only from explicit lead days and artist-entered target date rather than invented industry timing
provider scheduling, distribution upload, campaign send, pitch submission, spend, legal clearance, calendar and external-action authority remain hard-false
allowed_implementation_freedom: consumer presentation details that preserve state meaning
installer composition compatible with current runtime ownership
interpretations_required: re-audit current app_runtime.py and shared installer/composition ownership instead of replaying the historical patch mechanically
remaining_semantics: full REQ-SCOPE-026 provider/campaign dependencies remain outside this local readiness increment
